main_text.p: Onk. & Hierosol. Deinde קובְתָא est Aquæductus, fons, fonticulus, Psal.65.10. Job 38.25. ubi respondet Hebraeo תַּעְלָה, Genes.1.7. in Targ.Jon. pro quo alii legunt כיפה. Elias explicat גומר ובור, Fossam, foveam, cisternam.

קבל Ch. Obscurari, obtenebrari, tenebrescere. Deinde Clamare, vociferari, Genes.4.10. & Exo. 22.22. Hinc Syr.Præt.cum Aff. ܩܒܠܢܝ Compellavit me, Act.25.24. Partic. ܩܒܝܠܐ Cum clamaret, ad Rom.11.2. Fut. ܢܩܒܠ Quis clamabit contra electos Dei? ad Rom.8.33. Alii reddunt, Quis opponet se, ex significatione לוקבל, קבל Contra. Pahel קבל Ch.& Syr. Accipere, excipere, recipere, suscipere: cum de voce aut sermone usurpatur, est Audire, obedire: Item Clamare, ut in Kal. Item Obscurari, unde Fut. ויקבלון Et obscurabùtur, Jerem.4.27. Aphel אקביל Idem. Ithpahel אתקבל Accipi, recipi.
קבלתא, קבילא Ch. Clamor, vociferatio, Exod.22.22. & קבלא קבלתא Esth.1.10.
קבול Ch. Acceptio: בעידן קבול סובתא Tempore acceptionis immunditiei, i. quo impurus factus, Nu.19.18. Jon.
קבלא, קבלא, קבל קבלא קבל, & קבלא Ch. Tenebrae, Obtenebratio, obscuratio, caligo: Item Crepusculum, 1.Sam.30.17. Plur. קבליא, קבלין Psal.73.18.
ܩܒܘܠܐ Syr. Epulum, convivium, quasi Exceptio, ab excipiendis convivis, ut Græcum δοχή, Lucæ 5.29. &14.13.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are approximate; several vocalised Hebrew and Syriac words could not be read letter by letter and may be inaccurate. Points and superscript marks above Syriac words are simplified. The final line is a Syriac word set right-aligned at the foot.
